She is one of {{an|Professor Sycamore}}'s assistants. ==History== [[File:Cosette casual clothes.png|thumb|left|250px|Cosette in casual clothes]] Cosette first appeared in ''[[XY002|Lumiose City Pursuit!]]''. While {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were talking to Professor Sycamore, Cosette came by. Professor Sycamore had her look after the lab's {{p|Garchomp}} while he took the group outside. Cosette then researched Garchomp using a machine to learn about [[Mega Evolution]]. When {{TRT}} walked in, disguised as scientists, Cosette walked in with Garchomp as she and [[Sophie]] did not recall having them invited and would check with Professor Sycamore. However, before she did so, Team Rocket threw a mechanical collar at Garchomp even though it was meant for {{AP|Froakie}}. As Garchomp went on a rampage, Cosette ran outside and warned Professor Sycamore about what was going on. Cosette stayed behind in the lab while Ash and his friends went after Garchomp. In ''[[XY010|Mega-Mega Meowth Madness!]]'', Cosette cleared up the rubble Team Rocket had caused while kidnapping Professor Sycamore. From ''[[XY039|Summer of Discovery!]]'' to ''[[XY042|Battling Into the Hall of Fame!]]'', Cosette was part of the staff at [[Pokémon Summer Camp|the Professor's Summer Camp]]. Amongst her activities was refereeing a battle between Ash and {{an|Tierno}} and judging the teams in the various activities, and guiding the teams at a stamp table during the PokéEnteering competition in ''[[XY041|Foggy Pokémon Orienteering!]]''. In ''[[XY080|Performing with Fiery Charm!]]'', Cosette watched {{an|Serena}} competing in the [[Dendemille Town]] Rookie Class [[Pokémon Showcase]] alongside Professor Sycamore and Sophie. She briefly appeared again in ''[[XY092|Cloudy Fate, Bright Future!]]'' and ''[[XY093|All Eyes on the Future!]]''. In ''[[XY112|Master Class is in Session!]]'' and ''[[XY113|Performing a Pathway to the Future!]]'', Cosette was watching Serena's performance in the [[Gloire City]] Master Class Pokémon Showcase alongside Professor Sycamore and Sophie. In ''[[XY137|Battling With a Clean Slate!]]'', Cosette handed out medals to Ash, his friends, [[Alain]], [[Mairin]], and their Pokémon for their heroic efforts against [[Team Flare]]. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{y color light}}|bordercolor={{y color}} |ja=安野希世乃 ''Kiyono Yasuno'' |en=[[Eileen Stevens]] |fi=Saara Lehtonen ([[XY002]]-[[XY041]])
